attributes.norm_statement: In protected buildings, if the application is incompatible with the protection level, an alternative solution must ensure maximum technical and economic fire safety, and the final documentation must record usage limitations.

extraction_text: Example norm with complex applies_if condition

attributes.norm_statement: Buildings in certain use categories or exceeding size thresholds must comply with additional requirements.
attributes.applies_if: AREA.USAGE != BUILDING.USAGE AND ((AREA.USAGE == 'RESIDENTIAL.HOUSING') OR (AREA.USAGE IN ['LODGING','ADMINISTRATIVE','COMMERCIAL','EDUCATION'] AND AREA.SIZE > 500) OR (AREA.USAGE == 'PUBLIC.ASSEMBLY' AND AREA.OCCUPANCY > 500) OR (AREA.USAGE == 'PARKING' AND AREA.SIZE > 100))
